hero.eyebrow: A PERSONAL ARCHIVE OF WEB EXPERIMENTS
hero.description: I design and develop interactive websites where motion, technology, and a little curiosity create something unforgettable.

about.headline: Curiosity is the whole point.
about.paragraph1: I enjoy taking ideas from a rough sketch to something you can actually click, explore, and use. This portfolio is a space to experiment with design, motion, code, and everything in between.
about.paragraph2: For me, the best digital experiences are both expressive and accessible. Every interaction should have a reason to exist.
